title: Project Graph Context (v3)
description: Index graph over a project's design documents and registries. Hierarchy (D38, D39): Root -> system (at most one; premises, requirements) -> component -> group (classification read from the project's own design documents, may nest) -> feature -> function (a leaf = one class / module / package). Decisions and issues attach to the structure. Invariants not expressible in JSON Schema and enforced by the skill (rule R1): every key of `nodes` equals that node's `id`; `current_node` and every edge target exist in `nodes`; no self-edges; `part_of` is acyclic; `resolves` is decision->issue only and its target has issue_status resolved; `supersedes` and `refines` are decision->decision only; `source_ref` matches a `config.registries[].id_pattern` when registries are defined; non-component `code_targets` and `test_targets` fall under some component's `code_targets`; at most one system node; when a system exists every component is part_of it; a requirement is part_of the system; a group's `class` names a `config.classes` id.

$schema.description: Editor hint. Ignored by the skill.

current_node.description: The single node being worked on now, or null when no work is active. Must be a key of `nodes`. Written by /graph-hydrate and /graph-handover only.

nodes.description: All graph nodes keyed by node id. Each key must equal the `id` of its value.

nodeId.description: Stable node identifier: lowercase letters, digits, hyphen or underscore; must start with a letter or digit.

nodeType.description: system: the apex (D38): purpose, premises, values; at most one. requirement: a premise or requirement under the system that constrains nodes (affects). component: architectural unit (its code_targets are its root directories); part_of the system when one exists. group: a classification node (D38) with no code of its own; its class comes from config.classes. feature / function: design-document structure; a function without structure children is a leaf = one class / module / package (D39). decision / issue: registry entries attached to the structure. plan: what was planned (goal, approval, log); its steps are nodes part_of it. rule: a working rule the user set. task: manual use only; never generated by /graph-init.

wipStatus.description: PLANNED = not yet started (a plan step, D33 / D34 R-b); IN_PROGRESS; BLOCKED; DONE. On decision nodes it is the implementation state: PLANNED = decided, not yet implemented; IN_PROGRESS = being implemented; DONE = implemented (or nothing to implement); FOLDED = absorbed into the decision that supersedes it — kept as a hidden history node (D31, D37); also a group / feature / function dissolved by `dissolve` (D43). Not used on issue nodes (they carry issue_status).

issueStatus.description: State of an issue node. open; resolved (by a decision's `resolves` edge or by an action); transferred (handed to another project or session).

id.description: Node identifier. Must equal the key under which this node is stored in `nodes`.

docs.description: Documents describing this node. May be empty.

code_targets.description: Files or directories this node owns. For a component: its root directory(ies). For any other type: each path must fall under some component's code_targets; only leaves should hold code (D39, a check warning). May be empty.

test_targets.description: Test files of this node (D42): a unit test named after one class on that leaf; a behaviour / integration test on the node of the design document it verifies. Each path must fall under some component's code_targets. Structure nodes only.

class.description: group nodes only: the id of the config.classes entry this group stands for (D38).

part_of.description: Parent node (at most one). component -> system (when one exists); requirement -> system; group -> component or group; feature -> component or group; function -> feature or function; decision/issue -> the node it is attached to. The system has no parent. A node that is the target of part_of is an index node.

depends_on.description: Prerequisite or expectation. feature -> feature; feature/function -> function of another component (cross-component expectation); issue -> decision that raised it.

affects.description: Impact. decision -> component/feature/function it constrains; issue -> component/feature/function it impacts.

resolves.description: decision -> issue it resolves. Only on decision nodes; targets must be issue nodes.

supersedes.description: decision -> earlier decision it replaces. Only on decision nodes; targets must be decision nodes. A superseded decision with no other live in-edge is a fold candidate.

refines.description: decision -> earlier decision it narrows or details without replacing it (the target stays in force). Only on decision nodes; targets must be decision nodes. Never a fold candidate (u46).

source_ref.description: Registry id verbatim (e.g. D-022, TBD-24). decision and issue nodes only; single-valued: one node = one registry entry.

next.description: True on the item(s) to take up next (D33). feature / function / task / issue only. The Backlog view lists every node carrying it.

owner.description: Who resolves the issue. issue nodes only.

trigger.description: When, or on what event, the issue is taken up. issue nodes only.

file.description: The entity file holding this node's text (one file per node, docs/entities/<id>.md; plan integrity-store P1). Any node type. Written by graph_tool only; append-only. The node's `name` is a copy of the file's `# <id> — <name>` heading kept by the tool.

sha256.description: sha256 of `file` as last written by graph_tool; validate reports a file changed outside the tool (P2).

closed_by.description: What closed the issue: a decision registry id, a commit hash, or a short action text. issue nodes only; required when issue_status is not open.

id_pattern.description: Regular expression (ECMA-262 syntax) matching one registry id, e.g. ^D-\d{3}$.

file.description: Project-relative path of the registry file that holds the entries' text.

public_column.description: 1-based cell index (cell 1 = the id) of this registry's public-safe text; `migrate` copies it into each decision's `Public summary` section.

config.description: Project-wide settings written by the /graph-init Q&A and editable by hand. Deliberately absent: code_roots (derived from component nodes), project_name and version (owned by git / CLAUDE.md).

interaction_language.description: BCP-47 tag (e.g. ja, en). Language for every question, recommendation table, approval request and checklist shown to the user. Stored artifacts stay English.

design_root.description: Directory whose document structure the feature/function layer mirrors, e.g. docs/design/.

docs_scope.description: Glob patterns /graph-init reads to derive nodes. Default: <design_root>/**/*.md.

registries.description: How decision / issue ids are recognised and where their text lives.

plan_docs.description: Globs of plan documents that `migrate --plans` moves into plan entities (default docs/plan-*.md, docs/apply-*.md).

views.description: Generated documents people read (plan integrity-store P3): each is rendered from the graph + entity files on every accepted write and checked by validate (drift = hand edit or stale).

backlog_filter.description: Project default for which open issues the Backlog view lists (D33). Absent = all open issues. PLANNED / IN_PROGRESS / BLOCKED / next nodes are always listed; whatever the filter excludes is printed as a count per component. Command options override it per call.

classes.description: Classification of the structure (D38), read from the project's own design documents, never invented: one entry per class; rank orders dependencies (a depends_on from a lower rank to a higher rank is warned).

source.description: Document (and section) that defines the class.

leaf_unit.description: What one leaf stands for (D39): class (Java / Kotlin / C#: one file), module (Python / TypeScript / Rust: one file), package (Go: one directory).

source_extensions.description: File extensions of source files under component roots (e.g. .java); used to list code without a leaf (D39 G6) by name only.

child_threshold.description: Number of structure children above which check proposes regrouping a node (D39 G4). Default 7.

test_roots.description: Directories that hold test files (e.g. src/test/); used to list tests without a node (D42 T4).

test_kinds.description: Naming rules (fnmatch patterns on the file name) for test kinds (D42 T2): unit, integration, helper (helpers and fixtures are never test_targets).

growth_threshold.description: Number of attached decision + issue nodes at which /graph-handover proposes splitting a feature/function into children. Default 5.

install.description: Written by /graph-install for footprint verification on uninstall.
